enchantment.benssharks.seeking.desc: Thrown tridents home toward multiple targets. Each level adds 2 targets and 2 blocks of range.
enchantment.benssharks.serrated.desc: Weapon hits inflict Bleeding on the target.
enchantment.caverns_and_chasms.conceal.d: Adds 10 percentage points of stealth per level to a cowl, reducing mob detection range.
enchantment.caverns_and_chasms.extending: Adds 1 block of interaction reach per level while wearing a toolbelt.
enchantment.caverns_and_chasms.obscurity: Makes the cowl wearer fully invisible while crouching, preventing mobs from detecting them.
